# korean-word-of-the-day — static word bank and word clock, no external dependencies

## Data owned

| name | kind | database/location | purpose | migration filename |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `window.KOREAN_WORDS` | in-memory array | `words.js` | Word bank holding every word entry: Korean text, romanization, pronunciation, part of speech, meaning, syllables, and example sentences | N/A |

The word bank is a global `window.KOREAN_WORDS` array in `words.js`. Each entry includes `ko`, `roman`, `sound`, `pos`, `meaning`, `syl`, and `ex` fields. The first word is 설레다, ensuring day one matches the approved mockup.

## Data read

| name | kind | database/location | purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `index.html` | file | repo root | Entry point that loads `words.js` and renders the resting screen |

No other data is read. The system makes no API calls, uses no tokens, and performs no network requests.

## Access

No database, role, or grant exists. No secrets are stored or accessed. The system is two static files opened directly in a browser.

## Env keys

N/A: no environment keys are defined or read.

## External integrations

N/A: no external systems, APIs, devices, or other services are contacted. Word rotation is deterministic by date with no API, tokens, or network calls.

## Consumers

The resting screen design renders the word bank data directly. Adding a word is data-only, never a layout change, because the data shape mirrors exactly what the design renders.
